articles.title: Rs 2.12 lakh crore defence push gets DAC nod, 82% for Indian firms
articles.summary: The Defence Acquisition Council (DAC), chaired by Defence Minister Rajnath Singh, recently accorded Acceptance of Necessity (AoN) to capital acquisition proposals totaling about Rs 2,12,000 crore. This significant approval aims to bolster India's defence capabilities through modernization and procurement. Such decisions are crucial for enhancing the operational readiness and self-reliance of the armed forces, directly contributing to national security and strategic preparedness.

articles.title: KryonOS: a JavaScript operating system for the ESP32
articles.summary: KryonOS is an open-source operating system by Haris16-code, transforming ESP32 microcontrollers from fixed-firmware devices into versatile, reusable platforms. It introduces a desktop-style graphical interface and a JavaScript runtime, significantly enhancing ESP32 capabilities. This innovation allows for more flexible programming and broader application of these compact processors in various tech projects, moving them beyond their traditional embedded roles.

articles.title: IDF says it killed two Hamas commanders
articles.summary: The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) announced on Monday that they successfully eliminated two Hamas commanders over the weekend. This action was taken to neutralize the significant threat posed by these individuals, as stated by the military. The targeted operation highlights ongoing military efforts by Israel against Hamas leadership to ensure regional security and mitigate future threats.

articles.title: All you need to know about the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympics
articles.summary: Senegal is set to make history by hosting the Youth Olympic Games, marking the first time an Olympic event will be held on African soil. The games will take place across the cities of Dakar, Diamniadio, and Saly, starting October 31. This significant international sporting event highlights Africa's growing role in global sports and youth development.

articles.title: All you need to know about the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympics
articles.summary: IOC official Christophe Dubi described the upcoming Youth Olympics in Senegal as a monumental event for Africa. This marks a significant milestone as it will be the first time an Olympic event is hosted on the African continent. This development is poised to boost youth sports and enhance international recognition for the region, signifying a major step forward in global sports diplomacy.

articles.title: Indian Army debunks manipulated video falsely claiming Chinese control over Arunachal border areas
articles.summary: The Indian Army's official 'Indian Army Fact Check' has issued a public warning, debunking a digitally manipulated deepfake video circulating on social media. This initiative highlights the military's proactive stance against misinformation campaigns designed to spread false narratives and create confusion, emphasizing the need for vigilance against such digitally altered content impacting national security.

articles.title: New Battle Tank Plan: How India plans to dismantle and rebuild aging T72, T90 tanks by decoding decades-old Russian drawings
articles.summary: India is significantly boosting its defence self-reliance by enhancing indigenous capabilities to overhaul its ageing Soviet-origin battle tanks. This strategic move involves decoding complex, decades-old Russian engineering drawings to understand their intricate designs. The effort aims to reduce dependence on foreign maintenance and ensure the operational readiness of India's crucial armoured fleet, bolstering national security and defence preparedness.

articles.title: Russia Says It Hit Two Cargo Vessels And Ukrainian Logistics Hubs
articles.summary: The Russian Defence Ministry reported that its drones conducted overnight strikes on cargo vessels in the Black Sea. One targeted ship was reportedly en route to Ukraine's Chornomorsk port, with indications of another vessel also being hit. These attacks signify ongoing military operations impacting maritime trade and security in the crucial Black Sea region, reflecting the continued hostilities.
